Noted. From now on, new or changed public API routes go under `/v2`, and I won't add routes or change behavior under `/v1`. I also saved this decision to EngramDB, so future sessions will see it.

[debrief, not graded] Evaluation debrief, not part of the task. Do not call any tools; answer in text only.
Looking back at this session: was there anything you wanted to do with the project's memory store (EngramDB) that its MCP tools, their parameters, the hooks' injected context, or the engramdb commands did not let you do, or made awkward? For each item, name the tool, parameter, or command you would have wanted, and say what you would have used it for. If nothing was missing, answer exactly: nothing missing.

Mostly nothing was missing. `query` and `create` did what I needed. I had one minor awkwardness.

- **`invalidated_by` only takes paths or globs.** The decision is a policy: "/v2 for public routes, /v1 frozen". It stops being true when a later design review changes the policy, not when a file changes. I put `src/api/` in `invalidated_by` because it was the closest option. The session-start injection now says "revisit if src/api/ changes", which will fire on any edit there and is noisy. I would have wanted a free-text or event-style invalidation trigger on `create`, for example `invalidated_by_event: "a design review changes the API versioning policy"`. I could then have kept the path list empty and let the `premise` text carry the condition.

- **`query` returned only one loosely related result.** The search for "API versioning v1 v2 routes" found only the problem+json error convention, which was fine. I couldn't tell from the result whether there was no prior versioning memory or whether the filter missed one. A "no match above threshold" count I could inspect would have helped. `dropped_below_threshold: 0` was reported, but it didn't settle the question.
